title: ERNIE-Image-Turbo 8B Open-Weight Diffusion Transformer
summary: An 8-billion parameter text-to-image model by Baidu based on the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture. It utilizes Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) and reinforcement learning to generate high-fidelity images in just 8 inference steps.
research_notes: Widely recognized for its industry-leading text rendering capabilities and performance in generating complex layouts like infographics and storyboards.

evolution.summary: Baidu released the model weights under the Apache 2.0 license in April 2026, marking a strategic shift toward open-source accessibility. It has since gained native support in the Diffusers library and extensive ComfyUI integration.
